question: Ustad Asad Ali Khan played which of the following instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rudra Veena.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Asad Ali Khan** played the **Rudra Veena**, which is a **stringed instrument** used in Indian classical music.
 
• The Rudra Veena is known for its** deep, resonant sound **and is considered one of the oldest instruments in India.
 
• The **Hindu **referred to Khan, who played in the **dhrupad style,** as the greatest rudra veena player alive in India.
 
• In **2008,** he received the Indian civilian distinction of **Padma Bhushan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Rudra Veena** is often played by dhrupad musicians, who are known for their **slow and meditative style** of singing.
 
• The** Algoza** is typically played by two musicians simultaneously, with one playing the** melody **and the other playing the drone.
 
• **Algoza **is a **double flute** used in Punjabi folk music, while the** Sitar** is a **plucked string** instrument commonly used in Indian classical music.
 
• The Sitar is known for its d**istinctive sound** and is often used in film music as well as classical performances.
 
• **Ravanahatha **is traditionally played by a community of musicians known as** Bhopas**, who use the instrument to accompany their **epic storytelling** performances.
 
• Ravanahatha is a bowed string instrument used in** Rajasthan, India, **and is believed to be one of the oldest stringed instruments in the world.
